points.zh: $\mathrm{i}$ 是方程 $x^2+1=0$ 的解，满足 $\mathrm{i}^2=-1$。
points.en: $\mathrm{i}$ is a solution of $x^2+1=0$, so that $\mathrm{i}^2=-1$.

points.zh: 复数形如 $z=a+\mathrm{i}b$，其中 $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$；$a=\operatorname{Re} z$，$b=\operatorname{Im} z$；形如 $\mathrm{i}b$ 的数称为纯虚数，复数集记作 $\mathbb{C}$，且 $\mathbb{R}\subseteq\mathbb{C}$。
points.en: A complex number has the form $z=a+\mathrm{i}b$ with $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$; $a=\operatorname{Re} z$ and $b=\operatorname{Im} z$; a number of the form $\mathrm{i}b$ is purely imaginary; the set of complex numbers is $\mathbb{C}$ with $\mathbb{R}\subseteq\mathbb{C}$.

points.zh: 两个复数相等当且仅当实部与虚部分别相等：$a+\mathrm{i}b=c+\mathrm{i}d \iff a=c$ 且 $b=d$。
points.en: Two complex numbers are equal iff their real and imaginary parts agree: $a+\mathrm{i}b=c+\mathrm{i}d \iff a=c$ and $b=d$.

points.zh: 加法按部分相加：$(a+\mathrm{i}b)+(c+\mathrm{i}d)=(a+c)+\mathrm{i}(b+d)$。
points.en: Addition is done part by part: $(a+\mathrm{i}b)+(c+\mathrm{i}d)=(a+c)+\mathrm{i}(b+d)$.

points.zh: 乘法把 $\mathrm{i}$ 当符号并用 $\mathrm{i}^2=-1$：$(a+\mathrm{i}b)(c+\mathrm{i}d)=(ac-bd)+\mathrm{i}(ad+bc)$。
points.en: Multiplication treats $\mathrm{i}$ as a symbol with $\mathrm{i}^2=-1$: $(a+\mathrm{i}b)(c+\mathrm{i}d)=(ac-bd)+\mathrm{i}(ad+bc)$.

points.zh: 定义 3.1（共轭）：$z=a+\mathrm{i}b$ 的共轭为 $\bar z=a-\mathrm{i}b$，且 $z\bar z=(a+\mathrm{i}b)(a-\mathrm{i}b)=a^2+b^2$。
points.en: Definition 3.1 (complex conjugate): for $z=a+\mathrm{i}b$ the conjugate is $\bar z=a-\mathrm{i}b$, and $z\bar z=(a+\mathrm{i}b)(a-\mathrm{i}b)=a^2+b^2$.

points.zh: 命题 3.1：$\overline{z_1+z_2}=\bar z_1+\bar z_2$，$\overline{z_1\cdot z_2}=\bar z_1\cdot\bar z_2$，$\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$；因此当 $z\neq 0$ 时 $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|^2}$。
points.en: Proposition 3.1: $\overline{z_1+z_2}=\bar z_1+\bar z_2$, $\overline{z_1\cdot z_2}=\bar z_1\cdot\bar z_2$, $\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$; hence for $z\neq 0$, $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|^2}$.

points.zh: 复数 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ 对应坐标平面上的点 $(x,y)$，表示复数的图称为阿甘图（Argand diagram）。
points.en: The complex number $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ corresponds to the point $(x,y)$ in the coordinate plane; the diagram representing complex numbers is called an Argand diagram.
Definition 3.2 (modulus): $|z|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, and $|z|^2=z\bar z$.

points.zh: 定义 3.3（辐角）：$\arg z$ 是正实轴与原点到 $(x,y)$ 连线之间的角，只确定到相差 $2\pi$；主辐角 $\operatorname{Arg} z$ 取在 $(-\pi,\pi]$ 内。
points.en: Definition 3.3 (argument): $\arg z$ is the angle from the positive real axis to the line joining the origin to $(x,y)$, determined only up to multiples of $2\pi$; the principal argument $\operatorname{Arg} z$ is the one in $(-\pi,\pi]$.

points.zh: 直线轨迹：$z+\bar z=-8 \iff 2x=-8 \iff x=-4$（竖直线）；$z-\bar z=5\mathrm{i} \iff 2\mathrm{i}y=5\mathrm{i} \iff y=\dfrac{5}{2}$（水平线）。
points.en: Straight-line loci: $z+\bar z=-8 \iff 2x=-8 \iff x=-4$ (vertical line); $z-\bar z=5\mathrm{i} \iff 2\mathrm{i}y=5\mathrm{i} \iff y=\dfrac{5}{2}$ (horizontal line).

points.zh: 圆轨迹：$|z-3+2\mathrm{i}|=5$ 表示以点 $3-2\mathrm{i}$（即坐标 $(3,-2)$）为圆心、半径 $5$ 的圆。
points.en: Circular loci: $|z-3+2\mathrm{i}|=5$ is the circle with centre $3-2\mathrm{i}$, i.e. the point $(3,-2)$, and radius $5$.

points.zh: 射线轨迹：$\arg z=\dfrac{7\pi}{6}$ 表示从原点出发、与正实轴成 $\dfrac{7\pi}{6}$ 角的射线。
points.en: Ray loci: $\arg z=\dfrac{7\pi}{6}$ is the ray from the origin making an angle $\dfrac{7\pi}{6}$ with the positive real axis.

points.zh: 区域轨迹由不等式给出：$\dfrac{\pi}{6}\le \arg z<\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$ 表示一个扇形区域，阴影题要区分边界是否取到（实线表示含、虚线表示不含）。
points.en: Regions come from inequalities: $\dfrac{\pi}{6}\le \arg z<\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$ describes a sector; in shading questions one must keep track of whether a boundary is included (solid line) or not (dashed line).

points.zh: 定义 3.4（三角形式）：$z=r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)$，其中 $r=|z|$，$\theta=\arg z$。
points.en: Definition 3.4 (trigonometric form): $z=r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)$ where $r=|z|$ and $\theta=\arg z$.

points.zh: 定义 3.5（指数形式）：对任意实数 $\theta$ 定义 $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$，于是模为 $r$、辐角为 $\theta$ 的复数写成 $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$。
points.en: Definition 3.5 (exponential form): for any real $\theta$, $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$, and a complex number of modulus $r$ and argument $\theta$ is written $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$.

points.zh: 定理 3.2（指数运算律）：$e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_1}e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_2}=e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta_1+\theta_2)}$，$e^{-\mathrm{i}\theta}=\overline{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}}$，$\dfrac{1}{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}}=e^{-\mathrm{i}\theta}$，$\dfrac{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_1}}{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_2}}=e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta_1-\theta_2)}$。
points.en: Theorem 3.2 (exponential laws): $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_1}e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_2}=e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta_1+\theta_2)}$, $e^{-\mathrm{i}\theta}=\overline{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}}$, $\dfrac{1}{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}}=e^{-\mathrm{i}\theta}$, $\dfrac{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_1}}{e^{\mathrm{i}\theta_2}}=e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta_1-\theta_2)}$.

points.zh: 定理 3.3（模与辐角运算）：$|z_1z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$，$\left|\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\right|=\dfrac{|z_1|}{|z_2|}$，$\arg(z_1z_2)=\arg z_1+\arg z_2$，$\arg\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}=\arg z_1-\arg z_2$。
points.en: Theorem 3.3 (modulus and argument rules): $|z_1z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$, $\left|\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\right|=\dfrac{|z_1|}{|z_2|}$, $\arg(z_1z_2)=\arg z_1+\arg z_2$, $\arg\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}=\arg z_1-\arg z_2$.

points.zh: 定理 3.4（棣莫弗公式）：若 $z=r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$，则 $z^n=r^ne^{\mathrm{i}n\theta}=r^n(\cos n\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin n\theta)$。
points.en: Theorem 3.4 (De Moivre's formula): if $z=r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$, then $z^n=r^ne^{\mathrm{i}n\theta}=r^n(\cos n\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin n\theta)$.

points.zh: 例 3.19（由棣莫弗推导三倍角公式）：取 $z=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$，则 $(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)^3=\cos 3\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 3\theta$，比较实部得 $\cos 3\theta=4\cos^3\theta-3\cos\theta$。
points.en: Example 3.19 (deriving the triple-angle formula from De Moivre): take $z=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$, then $(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)^3=\cos 3\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 3\theta$; comparing real parts gives $\cos 3\theta=4\cos^3\theta-3\cos\theta$.

points.zh: 把两个辐角相加后须再化为 $(-\pi,\pi]$ 内的主辐角，例如 $\operatorname{Arg}(z_1z_2)=\operatorname{Arg}\big((\arg z_1+\arg z_2)\bmod 2\pi\big)$。
points.en: After adding two arguments one must reduce to the principal argument in $(-\pi,\pi]$, e.g. $\operatorname{Arg}(z_1z_2)=\operatorname{Arg}\big((\arg z_1+\arg z_2)\bmod 2\pi\big)$.

points.zh: 定义 3.6：若 $n$ 是正整数且 $w^n=z$，则称 $w$ 是 $z$ 的 $n$ 次根。
points.en: Definition 3.6: if $n$ is a positive integer and $w^n=z$, then $w$ is called the root of $z$ of index $n$.

points.zh: 设 $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$，则其 $n$ 次根为 $w_k=r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}=r^{1/n}\left(\cos\dfrac{\theta+2k\pi}{n}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\theta+2k\pi}{n}\right)$，$k=0,1,\dots,n-1$，共 $n$ 个。
points.en: If $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$, its $n$-th roots are $w_k=r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}=r^{1/n}\left(\cos\dfrac{\theta+2k\pi}{n}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\theta+2k\pi}{n}\right)$ for $k=0,1,\dots,n-1$; there are exactly $n$ of them.

points.zh: $n$ 个根在半径为 $r^{1/n}$ 的圆上等距分布，相邻两根对应的辐角相差 $\dfrac{2\pi}{n}$。
points.en: The $n$ roots lie on the circle of radius $r^{1/n}$ and are equally spaced, the arguments of consecutive roots differing by $\dfrac{2\pi}{n}$.

points.zh: 例 3.20：$-32\mathrm{i}$ 的五次根为 $w_k=2e^{\mathrm{i}(-\pi/2+2k\pi)/5}=2e^{\mathrm{i}(4k-1)\pi/10}$，$k=0,\dots,4$，并在阿甘图上表示。
points.en: Example 3.20: the fifth roots of $-32\mathrm{i}$ are $w_k=2e^{\mathrm{i}(-\pi/2+2k\pi)/5}=2e^{\mathrm{i}(4k-1)\pi/10}$ for $k=0,\dots,4$, and they are represented on an Argand diagram.

points.zh: 例 3.21：$-64$ 的六次根为 $w_k=2e^{\mathrm{i}(\pi+2k\pi)/6}$，$k=0,\dots,5$。
points.en: Example 3.21: the sixth roots of $-64$ are $w_k=2e^{\mathrm{i}(\pi+2k\pi)/6}$ for $k=0,\dots,5$.

points.zh: 解方程 $(z-c)^n=a$ 时先取 $n$ 次根再平移：$(z-c)^n=a \Rightarrow z=c+a^{1/n}$ 的所有 $n$ 个值（例 3.22 与习题 3.26 都是这种情形）。
points.en: To solve $(z-c)^n=a$ first take the $n$-th roots and then translate: $(z-c)^n=a \Rightarrow z=c+a^{1/n}$ taken over all $n$ values (as in Example 3.22 and Problem 3.26).

body.zh: 设 $z=a+\mathrm{i}b$，定义 3.1 给出 $\bar z=a-\mathrm{i}b$。共轭运算把实部留下、虚部变号，因此 $z+\bar z=2\operatorname{Re} z$ 与 $z-\bar z=2\mathrm{i}\operatorname{Im} z$ 是求轨迹最常用的两个等式。由定义 3.2，$|z|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 且 $|z|^2=z\bar z=a^2+b^2$，所以 $|z|^2$ 一定是实数且非负。注意 $z\bar z=\bar z z$，而 $\overline{z^2}=(\bar z)^2$。
body.en: Let $z=a+\mathrm{i}b$; Definition 3.1 gives $\bar z=a-\mathrm{i}b$. Conjugation keeps the real part and reverses the sign of the imaginary part, so $z+\bar z=2\operatorname{Re} z$ and $z-\bar z=2\mathrm{i}\operatorname{Im} z$ are the two identities most often used for loci. By Definition 3.2, $|z|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ and $|z|^2=z\bar z=a^2+b^2$, so $|z|^2$ is always real and non-negative. Note that $z\bar z=\bar z z$, while $\overline{z^2}=(\bar z)^2$.

body.zh: 由 $z\bar z=|z|^2$ 得 $z\neq 0$ 时 $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|^2}$，分母是模的平方而不是模。命题 3.1 给出共轭与加减乘除可交换：$\overline{z_1\pm z_2}=\bar z_1\pm\bar z_2$，$\overline{z_1z_2}=\bar z_1\bar z_2$，$\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$，而且共轭是二重的：$\overline{\bar z}=z$。
body.en: From $z\bar z=|z|^2$ we get, for $z\neq 0$, $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|^2}$; the denominator is the square of the modulus, not the modulus. Proposition 3.1 shows that conjugation commutes with the four arithmetic operations: $\overline{z_1\pm z_2}=\bar z_1\pm\bar z_2$, $\overline{z_1z_2}=\bar z_1\bar z_2$, $\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$, and conjugation is involutive: $\overline{\bar z}=z$.

body.zh: 阿甘图把复数 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ 画成平面上的点 $(x,y)$，横轴为实轴、纵轴为虚轴（点 $(0,0)$ 对应原点 $z=0$）。因此复数的一切代数关系都可以翻译成平面上的几何关系：共轭对应关于实轴的对称，$|z-a|$ 是 $z$ 的轨迹点到 $a$ 的距离，$\arg z$ 是该点与原点连线和正实轴的夹角。
body.en: An Argand diagram draws the complex number $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ as the point $(x,y)$, with the horizontal axis the real axis and the vertical axis the imaginary axis (the point $(0,0)$ corresponds to the origin $z=0$). Every algebraic relation between complex numbers therefore becomes a geometric statement: conjugation is reflection in the real axis, $|z-a|$ is the distance from the point $z$ to $a$, and $\arg z$ is the angle between the positive real axis and the line from the origin to the point.

body.zh: 定义 3.2 给出模 $|z|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$，它是非负实数，$|z|=0$ 当且仅当 $z=0$。定义 3.3 给出辐角 $\arg z$，它只确定到相差 $2\pi$，即 $\arg z=\theta+2k\pi$（$k\in\mathbb{Z}$）；主辐角 $\operatorname{Arg} z$ 唯一地取在 $(-\pi,\pi]$ 内。因此写 $\arg z$ 时应给出「所有」满足条件的角，而写 $\operatorname{Arg} z$ 时给出一个具体的角。
body.en: Definition 3.2 gives the modulus $|z|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, a non-negative real number with $|z|=0$ exactly when $z=0$. Definition 3.3 gives the argument $\arg z$, which is only determined up to multiples of $2\pi$, i.e. $\arg z=\theta+2k\pi$ for $k\in\mathbb{Z}$; the principal argument $\operatorname{Arg} z$ is the unique one in $(-\pi,\pi]$. So with $\arg z$ one should list all admissible angles, while $\operatorname{Arg} z$ is a single specific angle.

body.zh: 判别轨迹的步骤：先把条件里的 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ 写出来（注意 $\bar z=x-\mathrm{i}y$）；若条件只含实部则轨迹是竖直线，只含虚部则是水平线；形如 $|z-a|=r$ 的是以 $a$ 为圆心、$r$ 为半径的圆；含 $|z|^2$ 与 $\mathrm{i}z$、$\mathrm{i}\bar z$ 的式子可配方成 $|z-a|^2=r^2$；形如 $\arg z=\theta$ 的是射线，不等式则给出扇形。
body.en: To identify a locus: first write $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ (remember $\bar z=x-\mathrm{i}y$); if the condition involves only the real part the locus is a vertical line, and only the imaginary part gives a horizontal line; an expression $|z-a|=r$ is the circle with centre $a$ and radius $r$; expressions containing $|z|^2$ together with $\mathrm{i}z$ and $\mathrm{i}\bar z$ can be completed to $|z-a|^2=r^2$; a condition $\arg z=\theta$ gives a ray, and an inequality gives a sector.

body.zh: 定义 3.4 把 $z$ 写成 $r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)$，其中 $r=|z|$，$\theta=\arg z$；定义 3.5 再用 $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$ 把它压成 $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$。指数形式的好处是乘法、除法、乘方都变成指数的加减：定理 3.2 与定理 3.3 立即给出 $|z_1z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$、$\arg(z_1z_2)=\arg z_1+\arg z_2$ 以及 $\arg\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}=\arg z_1-\arg z_2$。
body.en: Definition 3.4 writes $z$ as $r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)$ with $r=|z|$ and $\theta=\arg z$; Definition 3.5 then compresses this with $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$ into $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$. The exponential form is useful because products, quotients and powers become additions and subtractions of exponents: Theorem 3.2 and Theorem 3.3 immediately give $|z_1z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$, $\arg(z_1z_2)=\arg z_1+\arg z_2$ and $\arg\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}=\arg z_1-\arg z_2$.

title.zh: 棣莫弗公式与多倍角公式
title.en: De Moivre's formula and multiple-angle identities

body.zh: 定理 3.4 给出棣莫弗公式 $z^n=r^ne^{\mathrm{i}n\theta}=r^n(\cos n\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin n\theta)$，它对任意整数 $n$ 都成立（$n<0$ 时用 $z^{-1}=\bar z/|z|^2$）。把 $z=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$ 代入棣莫弗公式并比较实部与虚部，可得 $\cos n\theta$ 与 $\sin n\theta$ 的多倍角公式；例 3.19 取 $n=3$ 得到 $\cos 3\theta=4\cos^3\theta-3\cos\theta$。
body.en: Theorem 3.4 gives De Moivre's formula $z^n=r^ne^{\mathrm{i}n\theta}=r^n(\cos n\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin n\theta)$, valid for every integer $n$ (for $n<0$ use $z^{-1}=\bar z/|z|^2$). Substituting $z=\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$ into De Moivre's formula and comparing real and imaginary parts yields the multiple-angle formulas for $\cos n\theta$ and $\sin n\theta$; Example 3.19 takes $n=3$ to get $\cos 3\theta=4\cos^3\theta-3\cos\theta$.

body.zh: 设 $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}=r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)$，则 $z$ 是实数当且仅当 $\sin\theta=0$（即 $\theta=k\pi$），$z$ 是纯虚数当且仅当 $\cos\theta=0$（即 $\theta=\dfrac{(2k+1)\pi}{2}$）。求整数 $n$ 使 $z^n$ 为实数或纯虚数时，就是令相应三角函数为零后解关于 $n$ 的方程；注意纯虚数还要求实部为零，即 $\operatorname{Re}(z^n)=0$。
body.en: Let $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}=r(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)$. Then $z$ is real iff $\sin\theta=0$ (i.e. $\theta=k\pi$), and $z$ is purely imaginary iff $\cos\theta=0$ (i.e. $\theta=\dfrac{(2k+1)\pi}{2}$). To find the integers $n$ for which $z^n$ is real or purely imaginary, set the corresponding trigonometric function to zero and solve for $n$; remember that a purely imaginary number must also have zero real part, i.e. $\operatorname{Re}(z^n)=0$.

body.zh: 由定义 3.6，$w^n=z$ 的解就是 $z$ 的 $n$ 次根。若 $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$，则由棣莫弗公式得 $w_k=r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}$，$k=0,1,\dots,n-1$：恰好 $n$ 个根，模都等于 $r^{1/n}$，辐角彼此相差 $\dfrac{2\pi}{n}$，因此它们正好处在以原点为圆心、半径 $r^{1/n}$ 的圆上等距分布，取遍 $k=0,\dots,n-1$ 就得到全部根。
body.en: By Definition 3.6, the solutions of $w^n=z$ are the roots of $z$ called $n$-th roots. If $z=re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$, De Moivre's formula gives $w_k=r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}$ for $k=0,1,\dots,n-1$: there are exactly $n$ roots, all of modulus $r^{1/n}$, whose arguments differ by $\dfrac{2\pi}{n}$, so they lie equally spaced on the circle with centre the origin and radius $r^{1/n}$; taking $k=0,\dots,n-1$ gives all of them.

title.zh: 用 n 次根解方程

body.zh: 形如 $(z-c)^n=a$（$a\neq 0$）的方程先令 $w=z-c$，把 $a$ 写成极形式 $re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$，再取 $n$ 次根，最后平移回去：$z=c+r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}$，$k=0,\dots,n-1$。阿甘图上这些解位于以 $c$ 为圆心、半径 $r^{1/n}$ 的圆上（习题 3.26 中 $c=2$、$r=3$）。
body.en: An equation of the form $(z-c)^n=a$ with $a\neq 0$ is solved by putting $w=z-c$, writing $a$ in polar form $re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$, taking the $n$-th roots and translating back: $z=c+r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}$ for $k=0,\dots,n-1$. On the Argand diagram these solutions lie on the circle with centre $c$ and radius $r^{1/n}$ (in Problem 3.26, $c=2$ and $r=3$).

body.zh: $\arg z$ 只确定到相差 $2\pi$，是一个族的概念；$\operatorname{Arg} z$ 才是 $(-\pi,\pi]$ 内的主辐角。做题时若题目要求「the argument」，应写成 $\arg z=\theta+2k\pi$（$k\in\mathbb{Z}$）；若要求「the principal argument」，才写 $\operatorname{Arg} z=\theta$。负实轴的辐角要注意：$\operatorname{Arg}(-7)=\pi$（不是 $-\pi$），因为主辐角区间是 $(-\pi,\pi]$ 左开右闭。
body.en: $\arg z$ is only determined up to multiples of $2\pi$ and denotes a family of angles; $\operatorname{Arg} z$ is the principal argument in $(-\pi,\pi]$. If the question asks for \"the argument\", write $\arg z=\theta+2k\pi$ with $k\in\mathbb{Z}$; only when it asks for \"the principal argument\" do you write $\operatorname{Arg} z=\theta$. Watch the negative real axis: $\operatorname{Arg}(-7)=\pi$ (not $-\pi$), because the principal range $(-\pi,\pi]$ is open on the left and closed on the right.

title.en: Misreading the centre of a circle

body.zh: $|z-a|=r$ 的圆心是复数 $a$ 本身，不是它的相反数也不是原点。习题 3.9 中 $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|=|z-(2-\mathrm{i})|$，圆心是 $(2,-1)$；讲义例 3.9 中 $|z-3+2\mathrm{i}|=|z-(3-2\mathrm{i})|$，圆心是 $(3,-2)$。正确做法是先把式子整理成 $|z-(a+\mathrm{i}b)|$ 的形式再读出圆心与半径。
body.en: The centre of $|z-a|=r$ is the complex number $a$ itself, not its opposite and not the origin. In Problem 3.9, $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|=|z-(2-\mathrm{i})|$ has centre $(2,-1)$; in Example 3.9, $|z-3+2\mathrm{i}|=|z-(3-2\mathrm{i})|$ has centre $(3,-2)$. The correct method is to rewrite the condition in the form $|z-(a+\mathrm{i}b)|$ before reading off the centre and the radius.

title.en: Open and closed boundaries in shading questions

body.zh: 不等式中的严格与非严格符号直接决定边界是否取到：$2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$ 中内圆 $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|=2$ 是虚线（不含），外圆 $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|=6$ 是实线（含）；$0<\arg z\le\pi$ 中正实轴要排除、负实轴要包含。做题时先在草稿上列出「哪几条边界取到、哪几条不取到」，再画图。
body.en: Strict and non-strict signs in an inequality decide whether a boundary is included: in $2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$ the inner circle $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|=2$ is dashed (excluded) and the outer circle $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|=6$ is solid (included); in $0<\arg z\le\pi$ the positive real axis is excluded while the negative real axis is included. A safe routine is to list first on paper which boundary curves are included and which are not, and only then draw.

title.zh: 共轭的分数线与倒数分母
title.en: Conjugating a fraction and the denominator of a reciprocal

body.zh: 由命题 3.1，$\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$，分子分母都要取共轭；而 $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|^2}$ 的分母是模的平方（习题 3.1(c) 中为 $2-7\mathrm{i}$，有理化后分母是 $4+49=53$）。容易错的地方是写成 $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|}$ 或忘记分母也要取共轭。
body.en: By Proposition 3.1, $\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$: both numerator and denominator are conjugated. And for a reciprocal, $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|^2}$ has the square of the modulus in the denominator (in Problem 3.1(c) with $2-7\mathrm{i}$ the rationalised denominator is $4+49=53$). The usual slips are writing $\dfrac{1}{z}=\dfrac{\bar z}{|z|}$ or forgetting to conjugate the denominator.

title.zh: 辐角相加后忘记化到主辐角
title.en: Forgetting to reduce the argument to the principal value

body.zh: 定理 3.3 给出的是 $\arg(z_1z_2)=\arg z_1+\arg z_2$，但两者都可以相差 $2\pi$ 的整数倍。习题 3.15 中 $\arg w$ 取 $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 或 $-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$，必须与 $\arg z=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$ 配对使用才得到主辐角 $\operatorname{Arg}(zw)=-\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$；若误用 $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\pi}{6}=\dfrac{13\pi}{12}$ 就不是主辐角了。
body.en: Theorem 3.3 gives $\arg(z_1z_2)=\arg z_1+\arg z_2$, but either side may differ by an integer multiple of $2\pi$. In Problem 3.15, $\arg w$ may be taken as $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ or $-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$; it must be paired with $\arg z=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$ to obtain the principal argument $\operatorname{Arg}(zw)=-\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$. Using $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\pi}{6}=\dfrac{13\pi}{12}$ would not be a principal argument.

title.zh: 实数与纯虚数的三角条件搞反
title.en: Swapping the real and purely imaginary conditions

body.zh: $re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$ 是实数当且仅当 $\sin\theta=0$；是纯虚数当且仅当 $\cos\theta=0$。习题 3.17(b) 求 $z^n$ 为实数得到 $\sin\frac{2\pi n}{3}=0$，即 $n=3m$；习题 3.18 求 $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n$ 为纯虚数得到 $\cos\frac{\pi n}{6}=0$，即 $n=6k+3$。两者条件恰好相反，切勿互换。
body.en: A number $re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$ is real iff $\sin\theta=0$, and purely imaginary iff $\cos\theta=0$. Problem 3.17(b) requires $z^n$ to be real, giving $\sin\frac{2\pi n}{3}=0$ and hence $n=3m$; Problem 3.18 requires $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n$ to be purely imaginary, giving $\cos\frac{\pi n}{6}=0$ and hence $n=6k+3$. The two conditions are mirror images and must not be interchanged.

title.zh: 取根时漏掉 2kπ 导致根不全
title.en: Dropping the 2kπ and getting too few roots

body.zh: 求 $n$ 次根时，被开方数要写成 $re^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)}$，其中 $k\in\mathbb{Z}$；取根后得 $w_k=r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}$，$k=0,1,\dots,n-1$。若只写 $re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$ 的单值而漏掉 $2k\pi$，就会只得到一个根（例如习题 3.24 会误以为只有 $3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}$ 一个根，而正确答案是四个等距分布的根）。
body.en: When taking $n$-th roots, the number under the root must be written as $re^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)}$ with $k\in\mathbb{Z}$; the roots are then $w_k=r^{1/n}e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta+2k\pi)/n}$ for $k=0,1,\dots,n-1$. Using only the single value $re^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$ and dropping the $2k\pi$ yields just one root — in Problem 3.24 one might wrongly get only $3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}$, whereas the correct answer has four equally spaced roots.

title.zh: 解方程忘记平移回原变量
title.en: Forgetting to translate back after taking roots

body.zh: 解 $(z-2)^5+243=0$ 时先得 $z-2=3e^{\mathrm{i}(2k+1)\pi/5}$，最后必须加回 $2$：$z=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}(2k+1)\pi/5}$，$k=0,\dots,4$。对应地，阿甘图上的根位于以 $2$（即点 $(2,0)$）为圆心、半径 $3$ 的圆上，而不是以原点为圆心。
body.en: To solve $(z-2)^5+243=0$ one first obtains $z-2=3e^{\mathrm{i}(2k+1)\pi/5}$ and must then add $2$ back: $z=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}(2k+1)\pi/5}$ for $k=0,\dots,4$. Correspondingly, on the Argand diagram the roots lie on the circle with centre $2$, i.e. the point $(2,0)$, and radius $3$ — not on a circle about the origin.

q.zh: 已知 $z=2-7\mathrm{i}$、$w=-3-2\mathrm{i}$，计算 $2z+3w$。
q.en: Given $z=2-7\mathrm{i}$ and $w=-3-2\mathrm{i}$, compute $2z+3w$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$2z+3w=2(2-7\mathrm{i})+3(-3-2\mathrm{i})=4-14\mathrm{i}-9-6\mathrm{i}=-5-20\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $2z+3w=2(2-7\mathrm{i})+3(-3-2\mathrm{i})=4-14\mathrm{i}-9-6\mathrm{i}=-5-20\mathrm{i}$.

q.zh: 已知 $z=2-7\mathrm{i}$、$w=-3-2\mathrm{i}$，计算 $z\bar w$。
q.en: Given $z=2-7\mathrm{i}$ and $w=-3-2\mathrm{i}$, compute $z\bar w$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$z\bar w=(2-7\mathrm{i})(-3+2\mathrm{i})=-6+4\mathrm{i}+21\mathrm{i}-14\mathrm{i}^2=8+25\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $z\bar w=(2-7\mathrm{i})(-3+2\mathrm{i})=-6+4\mathrm{i}+21\mathrm{i}-14\mathrm{i}^2=8+25\mathrm{i}$.

q.zh: 已知 $z=2-7\mathrm{i}$、$w=-3-2\mathrm{i}$，计算 $\dfrac{w^2}{z}$。
q.en: Given $z=2-7\mathrm{i}$ and $w=-3-2\mathrm{i}$, compute $\dfrac{w^2}{z}$.

steps.en: Multiply numerator and denominator by $\bar z=2+7\mathrm{i}$: $\dfrac{(5+12\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}{(2-7\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$\dfrac{w^2}{z}=\dfrac{(-3-2\mathrm{i})^2}{2-7\mathrm{i}}=\dfrac{(9+4\mathrm{i}^2+12\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}{(2-7\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}=\dfrac{(5+12\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}{4+49}=\dfrac{10-84+24\mathrm{i}+35\mathrm{i}}{53}=\dfrac{-74+59\mathrm{i}}{53}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $\dfrac{w^2}{z}=\dfrac{(-3-2\mathrm{i})^2}{2-7\mathrm{i}}=\dfrac{(9+4\mathrm{i}^2+12\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}{(2-7\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}=\dfrac{(5+12\mathrm{i})(2+7\mathrm{i})}{4+49}=\dfrac{10-84+24\mathrm{i}+35\mathrm{i}}{53}=\dfrac{-74+59\mathrm{i}}{53}$.

type.en: Solving an equation with a conjugate

q.zh: 求复数 $z$ 使 $2\bar z-z=5-6\mathrm{i}$。
q.en: Find a complex number $z$ such that $2\bar z-z=5-6\mathrm{i}$.

steps.en: Compare real and imaginary parts with $5-6\mathrm{i}$: $x=5$ and $-3y=-6$, so $y=2$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：设 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$，则 $5-6\mathrm{i}=2\bar z-z=2x-2\mathrm{i}y-x-\mathrm{i}y=x-3\mathrm{i}y$，故 $x=5$，$-3y=-6 \Rightarrow y=2$，即 $z=5+2\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: put $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$; then $5-6\mathrm{i}=2\bar z-z=2x-2\mathrm{i}y-x-\mathrm{i}y=x-3\mathrm{i}y$, so $x=5$ and $-3y=-6 \Rightarrow y=2$, i.e. $z=5+2\mathrm{i}$.

q.zh: 计算 $(1+\mathrm{i})^5$。
q.en: Compute $(1+\mathrm{i})^5$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$(1+\mathrm{i})^2=1+\mathrm{i}^2+2\mathrm{i}=2\mathrm{i}$；$(1+\mathrm{i})^4=(2\mathrm{i})^2=4\mathrm{i}^2=-4$；故 $(1+\mathrm{i})^5=-4(1+\mathrm{i})=-4-4\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $(1+\mathrm{i})^2=1+\mathrm{i}^2+2\mathrm{i}=2\mathrm{i}$; $(1+\mathrm{i})^4=(2\mathrm{i})^2=4\mathrm{i}^2=-4$; hence $(1+\mathrm{i})^5=-4(1+\mathrm{i})=-4-4\mathrm{i}$.

note.en: Check: $|-4-4\mathrm{i}|=4\sqrt{2}$; via De Moivre, $1+\mathrm{i}=\sqrt{2} e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}$ gives $(1+\mathrm{i})^5=2^{5/2}e^{\mathrm{i}5\pi/4}=-4-4\mathrm{i}$.

q.zh: 设 $z$ 为复数，证明 $\operatorname{Re}(\mathrm{i}z)=-\operatorname{Im} z$。
q.en: Given that $z$ is a complex number, show that $\operatorname{Re}(\mathrm{i}z)=-\operatorname{Im} z$.

steps.en: Put $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ with $x,y\in\mathbb{R}$, so $\operatorname{Re} z=x$ and $\operatorname{Im} z=y$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：设 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$，则 $\operatorname{Re} z=x$，$\operatorname{Im} z=y$；$\mathrm{i}z=\mathrm{i}x+\mathrm{i}^2y=-y+\mathrm{i}x$，所以 $\operatorname{Re}(\mathrm{i}z)=-y=-\operatorname{Im} z$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: put $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ so $\operatorname{Re} z=x$, $\operatorname{Im} z=y$; then $\mathrm{i}z=\mathrm{i}x+\mathrm{i}^2y=-y+\mathrm{i}x$, hence $\operatorname{Re}(\mathrm{i}z)=-y=-\operatorname{Im} z$.

note.zh: 对照讲义例 3.4（$3z+7\bar z=15-8\mathrm{i}$）可用同一技巧令 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$。
note.en: Compare with lecture Example 3.4 ($3z+7\bar z=15-8\mathrm{i}$), where the same trick $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$ is used.

q.zh: 设 $z$ 为复数，证明 $\operatorname{Im}(\mathrm{i}z)=\operatorname{Re} z$。
q.en: Given that $z$ is a complex number, show that $\operatorname{Im}(\mathrm{i}z)=\operatorname{Re} z$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：由 $\mathrm{i}z=\mathrm{i}x+\mathrm{i}^2y=-y+\mathrm{i}x$ 得 $\operatorname{Im}(\mathrm{i}z)=x=\operatorname{Re} z$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: from $\mathrm{i}z=\mathrm{i}x+\mathrm{i}^2y=-y+\mathrm{i}x$ we get $\operatorname{Im}(\mathrm{i}z)=x=\operatorname{Re} z$.

note.zh: 结论合起来说明乘以 $\mathrm{i}$ 就是把 $(x,y)$ 旋转 $90^\circ$：$\mathrm{i}(x+\mathrm{i}y)=(-y,x)$。
note.en: Together the two results say that multiplication by $\mathrm{i}$ rotates $(x,y)$ by $90^\circ$: $\mathrm{i}(x+\mathrm{i}y)=(-y,x)$.

type.en: Finding real and imaginary parts from an equation

q.zh: 求实数 $x$、$y$ 使 $(x+\mathrm{i}y)(3+4\mathrm{i})=20-7\mathrm{i}$。
q.en: Find real numbers $x$ and $y$ such that $(x+\mathrm{i}y)(3+4\mathrm{i})=20-7\mathrm{i}$.

steps.en: Multiply both sides by the conjugate $3-4\mathrm{i}$: $(x+\mathrm{i}y)(3+4\mathrm{i})(3-4\mathrm{i})=(20-7\mathrm{i})(3-4\mathrm{i})$.
The left side is $(x+\mathrm{i}y)(9+16)=25(x+\mathrm{i}y)$, the right side is $60-80\mathrm{i}-21\mathrm{i}+28\mathrm{i}^2=32-101\mathrm{i}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$(x+\mathrm{i}y)(3+4\mathrm{i})(3-4\mathrm{i})=(20-7\mathrm{i})(3-4\mathrm{i})$；$(x+\mathrm{i}y)(9+16)=32-101\mathrm{i}$；故 $x+\mathrm{i}y=\dfrac{32-101\mathrm{i}}{25}$，$x=\dfrac{32}{25}$，$y=\dfrac{-101}{25}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $(x+\mathrm{i}y)(3+4\mathrm{i})(3-4\mathrm{i})=(20-7\mathrm{i})(3-4\mathrm{i})$; $(x+\mathrm{i}y)(9+16)=32-101\mathrm{i}$; hence $x+\mathrm{i}y=\dfrac{32-101\mathrm{i}}{25}$, so $x=\dfrac{32}{25}$ and $y=\dfrac{-101}{25}$.

q.zh: 设 $z\neq 0$ 为复数且 $\dfrac{z}{\bar z}=a+\mathrm{i}b$（$a,b$ 为实数），证明 $a^2+b^2=1$。
q.en: If $z\neq 0$ is a complex number and $\dfrac{z}{\bar z}=a+\mathrm{i}b$ with $a,b$ real, show that $a^2+b^2=1$.

steps.zh: 由命题 3.1，$\overline{\dfrac{z}{\bar z}}=\dfrac{\bar z}{\overline{\bar z}}=\dfrac{\bar z}{z}$，故原式为 $\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\cdot\dfrac{\bar z}{z}=1$。
steps.en: By Proposition 3.1, $\overline{\dfrac{z}{\bar z}}=\dfrac{\bar z}{\overline{\bar z}}=\dfrac{\bar z}{z}$, so the expression equals $\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\cdot\dfrac{\bar z}{z}=1$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$a^2+b^2=(a+\mathrm{i}b)(a-\mathrm{i}b)=\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\,\overline{\left(\frac{z}{\bar z}\right)}=\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\times\dfrac{\bar z}{z}=1$；旁注 $\overline{\left(\frac{z}{\bar z}\right)}=\frac{\bar z}{\overline{\bar z}}=\frac{\bar z}{z}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $a^2+b^2=(a+\mathrm{i}b)(a-\mathrm{i}b)=\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\,\overline{\left(\frac{z}{\bar z}\right)}=\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\times\dfrac{\bar z}{z}=1$, with the side note $\overline{\left(\frac{z}{\bar z}\right)}=\frac{\bar z}{\overline{\bar z}}=\frac{\bar z}{z}$.

note.zh: 另一种看法：$\left|\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\right|=1$，故 $a^2+b^2=\left|\dfrac{z}{\bar z}\right|^2=1$。

q.zh: 求 $-3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$ 的模与辐角。
q.en: Find the modulus and argument of $-3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$.

steps.zh: 该点在第三象限，与负实轴所夹的参考角为 $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$（因 $\tan\dfrac{\pi}{6}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$）。
steps.en: The point lies in the third quadrant and makes a reference angle $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$ with the negative real axis (since $\tan\dfrac{\pi}{6}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$).

official.zh: 官方手写解答：第三象限作图，参考角 $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$；$|-3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{9+3}=\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}$，$\arg(-3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i})=\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\pi=\dfrac{7\pi}{6}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: a diagram in the third quadrant with reference angle $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$; $|-3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{9+3}=\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}$ and $\arg(-3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i})=\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\pi=\dfrac{7\pi}{6}$.

note.zh: 官方解答给出的是 $\arg$（含 $2\pi$ 的整倍数）；若题目只要主辐角，应答 $\operatorname{Arg}=-\dfrac{5\pi}{6}$。
note.en: The official solution gives $\arg$ (including the multiples of $2\pi$); if only the principal argument is asked for, answer $\operatorname{Arg}=-\dfrac{5\pi}{6}$.

q.zh: 求 $6+6\mathrm{i}$ 的模与辐角。
q.en: Find the modulus and argument of $6+6\mathrm{i}$.

steps.zh: 该点在第一象限，实部与虚部相等，故辐角为 $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$。
steps.en: The point lies in the first quadrant with equal real and imaginary parts, so the argument is $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：第一象限作图，角度 $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$；$|6+6\mathrm{i}|=6\sqrt{2}$，$\arg(6+6\mathrm{i})=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: a diagram in the first quadrant with angle $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$; $|6+6\mathrm{i}|=6\sqrt{2}$ and $\arg(6+6\mathrm{i})=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$.

q.zh: 求 $2\sqrt{3}-6\mathrm{i}$ 的模与辐角。
q.en: Find the modulus and argument of $2\sqrt{3}-6\mathrm{i}$.

steps.zh: 该点在第四象限，$\dfrac{6}{2\sqrt{3}}=\sqrt{3}$，即参考角为 $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$。
steps.en: The point lies in the fourth quadrant and $\dfrac{6}{2\sqrt{3}}=\sqrt{3}$, so the reference angle is $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：第四象限作图，与正实轴所夹角为 $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$；$\dfrac{6}{2\sqrt{3}}=\sqrt{3}$；$|2\sqrt{3}-6\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{12+36}=\sqrt{48}=4\sqrt{3}$，$\arg(2\sqrt{3}-6\mathrm{i})=-\dfrac{\pi}{3}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: a diagram in the fourth quadrant with angle $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ below the positive real axis; $\dfrac{6}{2\sqrt{3}}=\sqrt{3}$; $|2\sqrt{3}-6\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{12+36}=\sqrt{48}=4\sqrt{3}$ and $\arg(2\sqrt{3}-6\mathrm{i})=-\dfrac{\pi}{3}$.

type.en: Modulus and argument on the negative real axis

q.zh: 求 $-7$ 的模与辐角。
q.en: Find the modulus and argument of $-7$.

steps.zh: $-7$ 在负实轴上，辐角为 $\pi$（加上 $2\pi$ 的整数倍即全体辐角）。
steps.en: $-7$ lies on the negative real axis, so its argument is $\pi$ (plus integer multiples of $2\pi$ for all arguments).
The principal argument is $\operatorname{Arg}(-7)=\pi$ (the principal range is $(-\pi,\pi]$).

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$-7$ 标在负实轴上；$|-7|=7$，$\arg(-7)=\pi$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $-7$ is marked on the negative real axis; $|-7|=7$ and $\arg(-7)=\pi$.

note.zh: 易错点：负实轴的主辐角是 $\pi$ 而不是 $-\pi$，因为区间 $(-\pi,\pi]$ 左开右闭。
note.en: Pitfall: the principal argument on the negative real axis is $\pi$, not $-\pi$, since the range $(-\pi,\pi]$ is open on the left and closed on the right.

type.en: Modulus and argument on the positive imaginary axis

q.zh: 求 $5\mathrm{i}$ 的模与辐角。
q.en: Find the modulus and argument of $5\mathrm{i}$.

steps.zh: $5\mathrm{i}$ 在正虚轴上，与正实轴所夹角为 $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$。
steps.en: $5\mathrm{i}$ lies on the positive imaginary axis and makes an angle $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ with the positive real axis.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：在阿甘图上把 $5\mathrm{i}$ 标在正虚轴上；$|5\mathrm{i}|=5$，$\arg(5\mathrm{i})=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $5\mathrm{i}$ is plotted on the positive imaginary axis of the Argand diagram; $|5\mathrm{i}|=5$ and $\arg(5\mathrm{i})=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$.

note.zh: 本题的手写解答印在官方详解第 8 页（该页与第 7 页同为第 3.7 题）。
note.en: The handwritten solution for this part appears on page 8 of the official solutions (the same page group as Question 3.7).

q.zh: 在复平面上画出满足 $-7<z+\bar z<10$ 的区域。
q.en: Shade the region in the complex plane that satisfies $-7<z+\bar z<10$.

ans.zh: 区域为竖直带 $-\dfrac{7}{2}<\operatorname{Re} z<5$（两条竖直边界 $\operatorname{Re} z=-\dfrac{7}{2}$ 与 $\operatorname{Re} z=5$ 均为虚线，不含边界）
ans.en: The region is the vertical strip $-\dfrac{7}{2}<\operatorname{Re} z<5$ (both boundary lines $\operatorname{Re} z=-\dfrac{7}{2}$ and $\operatorname{Re} z=5$ are dashed, so the boundaries are excluded)

steps.zh: 这是两条竖直线 $-\dfrac{7}{2}$ 与 $5$ 之间的开带状区域。
steps.en: This is the open strip between the two vertical lines $-\dfrac{7}{2}$ and $5$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$z+\bar z=2x$，故 $-7<z+\bar z<10$ 即区域 $-\dfrac{7}{2}<x<5$；图中在 $x=-\dfrac{7}{2}$ 与 $x=5$ 处画虚线，两线之间的带状区域涂浅绿色。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $z+\bar z=2x$, so $-7<z+\bar z<10$ is the region $-\dfrac{7}{2}<x<5$; the sketch shows dashed vertical lines at $x=-\dfrac{7}{2}$ and $x=5$ with the strip between them shaded in light green.

note.zh: 注意不等号是严格的，两条边界都不取，因此画成虚线。
note.en: Note that both inequality signs are strict, so neither boundary is included and both are drawn dashed.

q.zh: 在复平面上画出满足 $2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$ 的区域。
q.en: Shade the region in the complex plane that satisfies $2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$.

ans.zh: 区域为以 $(2,-1)$ 为圆心、外半径 $6$（实线，含）与内半径 $2$（虚线，不含）之间的圆环
ans.en: The region is the annulus with centre $(2,-1)$ between the outer circle of radius $6$ (solid, included) and the inner circle of radius $2$ (dashed, excluded)

steps.zh: $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|$ 是点 $(x,y)$ 到点 $(2,-1)$ 的距离。
$2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$ 表示在半径 $6$ 的圆盘内但在半径 $2$ 的圆盘外：内边界不含、外边界含。
steps.en: $2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$ is inside the circle of radius $6$ but outside the circle of radius $2$: the inner boundary is excluded and the outer boundary is included.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：设 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$；$|z-2+\mathrm{i}|$ 是 $(x,y)$ 与 $(2,-1)$ 之间的距离；$2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$ 是半径 $2$ 的圆之外、半径 $6$ 的圆之内（含）的区域，圆心为 $(2,-1)$，图中内圆画虚线、外圆画实线，环状部分涂红色。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: put $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$; $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|$ is the distance between $(x,y)$ and $(2,-1)$; $2<|z-2+\mathrm{i}|\le 6$ is the region outside the circle of radius $2$ and inside (and on) the circle of radius $6$, both centred at $(2,-1)$; the sketch has a dashed inner circle, a solid outer circle and the annulus shaded in red.

note.en: Pitfall: the centre is $(2,-1)$ because $|z-2+\mathrm{i}|=|z-(2-\mathrm{i})|$, not $(2,1)$.

type.zh: 阴影区域（半平面与辐角）
type.en: Shading a half-plane from an argument condition

q.zh: 在复平面上画出满足 $0<\arg z\le\pi$ 的区域。
q.en: Shade the region in the complex plane that satisfies $0<\arg z\le\pi$.

ans.zh: 区域为上半平面（$y>0$），负实轴含（实线），正实轴不含（虚线），原点不含
ans.en: The region is the upper half-plane ($y>0$); the negative real axis is included (solid), the positive real axis is excluded (dashed), and the origin is excluded

steps.zh: $\arg z$ 是从正实轴到 $z$ 的辐角，$0<\arg z\le\pi$ 表示辐角在正实轴之上（逆时针）到负实轴之间的那些角。
steps.en: $\arg z$ is the angle from the positive real axis to $z$; $0<\arg z\le\pi$ selects the angles between the positive real axis (counterclockwise) and the negative real axis.

steps.zh: 因此是上半平面，但负实轴（辐角 $\pi$）要取到、正实轴（辐角 $0$）不取。
steps.en: So it is the upper half-plane, with the negative real axis (argument $\pi$) included and the positive real axis (argument $0$) excluded.

steps.zh: 原点处 $\arg 0$ 无定义，故 $z=0$ 不在区域内。
steps.en: At the origin $\arg 0$ is undefined, so $z=0$ is not in the region.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：整个上半平面（$y>0$）涂粉色；负实轴（$\arg z=\pi$）画实线表示含，正实轴（$\arg z=0$）画虚线表示不含；原点排除（$\arg 0$ 无定义）。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: the whole upper half-plane ($y>0$) is shaded in pink; the negative real axis ($\arg z=\pi$) is drawn solid to show it is included, the positive real axis ($\arg z=0$) is drawn dashed to show it is excluded, and the origin is excluded because $\arg 0$ is undefined.

note.zh: 对照讲义例 3.11（$\dfrac{\pi}{6}\le\arg z<\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$）可见扇形题总是「一边实线、一边虚线」。
note.en: Compare with lecture Example 3.11 ($\dfrac{\pi}{6}\le\arg z<\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$): in sector questions one side is solid and the other dashed.

q.zh: 求点 $z$ 满足 $|z|^2-(2-\mathrm{i})z-(2+\mathrm{i})\bar z=7$ 时的轨迹。
q.en: Find the locus of the points $z$ that satisfy $|z|^2-(2-\mathrm{i})z-(2+\mathrm{i})\bar z=7$.

ans.zh: 轨迹是以 $(2,1)$ 为圆心、半径 $\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}$ 的圆
ans.en: The locus is the circle with centre $(2,1)$ and radius $\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}$

steps.zh: 注意 $|z|^2=z\bar z$，把等式两边加上 $(2-\mathrm{i})(2+\mathrm{i})=5$：
steps.en: Note that $|z|^2=z\bar z$; adding $(2-\mathrm{i})(2+\mathrm{i})=5$ to both sides gives

steps.zh: 左边可配方为 $(z-(2+\mathrm{i}))(\bar z-(2-\mathrm{i}))=|z-(2+\mathrm{i})|^2$，故 $|z-(2+\mathrm{i})|^2=12$，即以 $2+\mathrm{i}$（点 $(2,1)$）为圆心、半径 $\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}$ 的圆。
steps.en: The left side factors as $(z-(2+\mathrm{i}))(\bar z-(2-\mathrm{i}))=|z-(2+\mathrm{i})|^2$, so $|z-(2+\mathrm{i})|^2=12$, the circle with centre $2+\mathrm{i}$, i.e. $(2,1)$, and radius $\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$z\bar z-(2-\mathrm{i})z-(2+\mathrm{i})\bar z+(2-\mathrm{i})(2+\mathrm{i})=7+(2-\mathrm{i})(2+\mathrm{i})$；$(z-(2+\mathrm{i}))(\bar z-(2-\mathrm{i}))=7+5=12$；$|z-(2+\mathrm{i})|^2=12$；故为以 $(2,1)$ 为圆心、半径 $\sqrt{12}$ 的圆。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $z\bar z-(2-\mathrm{i})z-(2+\mathrm{i})\bar z+(2-\mathrm{i})(2+\mathrm{i})=7+(2-\mathrm{i})(2+\mathrm{i})$; $(z-(2+\mathrm{i}))(\bar z-(2-\mathrm{i}))=7+5=12$; $|z-(2+\mathrm{i})|^2=12$; hence a circle with centre $(2,1)$ and radius $\sqrt{12}$.

note.zh: 易错点：配方后要确认圆心是 $2+\mathrm{i}$（即 $(2,1)$），对应原式中系数 $(2-\mathrm{i})z$ 与 $(2+\mathrm{i})\bar z$ 的位置。
note.en: Pitfall: after completing the square check the centre is $2+\mathrm{i}$, i.e. $(2,1)$, matching the placement of the coefficients $(2-\mathrm{i})z$ and $(2+\mathrm{i})\bar z$ in the original equation.

type.en: Solving an equation with a conjugate and a modulus

q.zh: 求复数 $z$ 满足 $4z+\bar z=|z|^2-6\mathrm{i}$ 时的取值。
q.en: Find the complex numbers $z$ that satisfy $4z+\bar z=|z|^2-6\mathrm{i}$.

steps.en: Comparing imaginary parts gives $3y=-6$, so $y=-2$; comparing real parts gives $5x=x^2+y^2=x^2+4$, i.e. $x^2-5x+4=(x-1)(x-4)=0$, so $x=1$ or $x=4$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：设 $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$；$4z+\bar z=|z|^2-6\mathrm{i}$；$4x+4\mathrm{i}y+x-\mathrm{i}y=x^2+y^2-6\mathrm{i}$；$5x+3\mathrm{i}y=x^2+y^2-6\mathrm{i}$；$5x=x^2+y^2$，$3y=-6 \Rightarrow y=-2$；$x^2-5x+4=0$，$(x-1)(x-4)=0$，$x=1$ 或 $x=4$；故 $z=1-2\mathrm{i}$ 或 $4-2\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: put $z=x+\mathrm{i}y$; $4z+\bar z=|z|^2-6\mathrm{i}$; $4x+4\mathrm{i}y+x-\mathrm{i}y=x^2+y^2-6\mathrm{i}$; $5x+3\mathrm{i}y=x^2+y^2-6\mathrm{i}$; $5x=x^2+y^2$, $3y=-6 \Rightarrow y=-2$; $x^2-5x+4=0$, $(x-1)(x-4)=0$, $x=1$ or $x=4$; hence $z=1-2\mathrm{i}$ or $4-2\mathrm{i}$.

type.en: Finding complex numbers from two conditions

q.zh: 求复数 $z$ 满足 $\operatorname{Re} z=\sqrt{3}$ 且 $|z|=2$ 时的取值。
q.en: Find the complex numbers $z$ that satisfy $\operatorname{Re} z=\sqrt{3}$ and $|z|=2$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$z=\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i}y$，$y\in\mathbb{R}$；$|z|=2 \Rightarrow 3+y^2=4$；$y^2=1$，$y=\pm 1$；故 $z=\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i}$ 或 $z=\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $z=\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i}y$ with $y\in\mathbb{R}$; $|z|=2 \Rightarrow 3+y^2=4$; $y^2=1$ so $y=\pm 1$; hence $z=\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i}$ or $z=\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}$.

note.zh: 几何解释：半径为 $2$ 的圆与竖直线 $x=\sqrt{3}$ 的两个交点。
note.en: Geometric view: the two intersection points of the circle of radius $2$ with the vertical line $x=\sqrt{3}$.

q.zh: 设 $z=2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$，$w=4\left(\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{4}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)$，计算 $zw$（答案保留三角形式）。
q.en: Let $z=2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$ and $w=4\left(\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{4}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)$; compute $zw$, leaving the answer in trigonometric form.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$zw=8\left(\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)+\mathrm{i}\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)\right)=8\left(\cos\dfrac{17\pi}{12}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{17\pi}{12}\right)$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $zw=8\left(\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)+\mathrm{i}\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)\right)=8\left(\cos\dfrac{17\pi}{12}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{17\pi}{12}\right)$.

note.zh: $\dfrac{17\pi}{12}$ 已超出主辐角区间 $(-\pi,\pi]$，但题目要求保留三角形式故不必化简。
note.en: $\dfrac{17\pi}{12}$ lies outside the principal range $(-\pi,\pi]$, but the question asks for trigonometric form so no reduction is needed.

q.zh: 设 $z=2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$，$w=4\left(\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{4}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)$，计算 $\dfrac{z}{\bar w}$（答案保留三角形式）。
q.en: Let $z=2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$ and $w=4\left(\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{4}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)$; compute $\dfrac{z}{\bar w}$, leaving the answer in trigonometric form.

steps.en: The numerator is the $zw$ of part (a), $8\left(\cos\dfrac{17\pi}{12}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{17\pi}{12}\right)$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$\dfrac{z}{\bar w}=\dfrac{zw}{w\bar w}=\dfrac{8\left(\cos\dfrac{17\pi}{12}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{17\pi}{12}\right)}{4^2}=\dfrac{1}{2}\left(\cos\dfrac{17\pi}{12}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{17\pi}{12}\right)$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $\dfrac{z}{\bar w}=\dfrac{zw}{w\bar w}=\dfrac{8\left(\cos\dfrac{17\pi}{12}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{17\pi}{12}\right)}{4^2}=\dfrac{1}{2}\left(\cos\dfrac{17\pi}{12}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{17\pi}{12}\right)$.

note.zh: 另一种做法：$\bar w$ 的模仍为 $4$，辐角为 $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}-\pi=-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$，故商的模为 $\dfrac{2}{4}=\dfrac{1}{2}$、辐角为 $\dfrac{\pi}{6}-\left(-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}\right)=\dfrac{17\pi}{12}$。
note.en: Alternative: $\bar w$ has modulus $4$ and argument $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}-\pi=-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$, so the quotient has modulus $\dfrac{2}{4}=\dfrac{1}{2}$ and argument $\dfrac{\pi}{6}-\left(-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}\right)=\dfrac{17\pi}{12}$.

type.en: Modulus and principal argument of a product

q.zh: 已知 $z=3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$，$w=-5\sqrt{2}-5\sqrt{2}\mathrm{i}$，求 $zw$ 的模与主辐角。
q.en: Given $z=3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$ and $w=-5\sqrt{2}-5\sqrt{2}\mathrm{i}$, find the modulus and principal argument of $zw$.

steps.en: $|w|=5\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1+1}=10$; it lies in the third quadrant so $\arg w=\dfrac{5\pi}{4}=-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$|z|=\sqrt{9+3}=2\sqrt{3}$，$\arg z=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$；$|w|=5\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1+1}=10$，$\arg w=\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 或 $-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$；$|zw|=|z||w|=20\sqrt{3}$；$\arg(zw)=\arg z+\arg w=-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$，故 $\operatorname{Arg}(zw)=-\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $|z|=\sqrt{9+3}=2\sqrt{3}$, $\arg z=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$; $|w|=5\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1+1}=10$, $\arg w=\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ or $-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$; $|zw|=|z||w|=20\sqrt{3}$; $\arg(zw)=\arg z+\arg w=-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$, so $\operatorname{Arg}(zw)=-\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$.

note.zh: 易错点：必须用 $-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$ 而不是 $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 与 $\arg z$ 相加，否则得到 $\dfrac{13\pi}{12}$ 不在主辐角区间。
note.en: Pitfall: one must use $-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$ rather than $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ when adding to $\arg z$, otherwise one gets $\dfrac{13\pi}{12}$, which is not a principal argument.

type.en: Modulus and principal argument of a quotient

q.zh: 已知 $z=3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$，$w=-5\sqrt{2}-5\sqrt{2}\mathrm{i}$，求 $\dfrac{w}{z}$ 的模与主辐角。
q.en: Given $z=3-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$ and $w=-5\sqrt{2}-5\sqrt{2}\mathrm{i}$, find the modulus and principal argument of $\dfrac{w}{z}$.

steps.en: Since $-\dfrac{7\pi}{12}\in(-\pi,\pi]$, it is already the principal argument.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$\left|\dfrac{w}{z}\right|=\dfrac{|w|}{|z|}=\dfrac{10}{2\sqrt{3}}=\dfrac{5}{\sqrt{3}}$；$\arg\left(\dfrac{w}{z}\right)=\arg w-\arg z=-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}+\dfrac{\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$；故 $\operatorname{Arg}\left(\dfrac{w}{z}\right)=-\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $\left|\dfrac{w}{z}\right|=\dfrac{|w|}{|z|}=\dfrac{10}{2\sqrt{3}}=\dfrac{5}{\sqrt{3}}$; $\arg\left(\dfrac{w}{z}\right)=\arg w-\arg z=-\dfrac{3\pi}{4}+\dfrac{\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$; hence $\operatorname{Arg}\left(\dfrac{w}{z}\right)=-\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$.

note.zh: 核对：$\dfrac{w}{z}=\dfrac{(-5\sqrt{2}-5\sqrt{2}\mathrm{i})(3+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i})}{12}=\dfrac{-15\sqrt{2}+15\sqrt{2} + (-5\sqrt{6}-15\sqrt{2})\mathrm{i}}{12}$，实部为 $0$，故为纯虚数，与辐角 $-\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$ 相符。
note.en: Check: $\dfrac{w}{z}=\dfrac{(-5\sqrt{2}-5\sqrt{2}\mathrm{i})(3+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i})}{12}=\dfrac{-15\sqrt{2}+15\sqrt{2} + (-5\sqrt{6}-15\sqrt{2})\mathrm{i}}{12}$; the real part is $0$, so the quotient is purely imaginary, matching the argument $-\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$.

q.zh: 化简 $(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)(\cos 2\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 2\theta)(\cos 4\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 4\theta)(\cos 8\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 8\theta)$。
q.en: Simplify $(\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta)(\cos 2\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 2\theta)(\cos 4\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 4\theta)(\cos 8\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 8\theta)$.

steps.zh: 用 $e^{\mathrm{i}\phi}=\cos\phi+\mathrm{i}\sin\phi$ 把四个因子写成 $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$、$e^{-2\mathrm{i}\theta}$、$e^{4\mathrm{i}\theta}$、$e^{-8\mathrm{i}\theta}$。
steps.en: Using $e^{\mathrm{i}\phi}=\cos\phi+\mathrm{i}\sin\phi$, write the four factors as $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$, $e^{-2\mathrm{i}\theta}$, $e^{4\mathrm{i}\theta}$ and $e^{-8\mathrm{i}\theta}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta=e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$，$\cos 2\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 2\theta=e^{-2\mathrm{i}\theta}$，$\cos 4\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 4\theta=e^{4\mathrm{i}\theta}$，$\cos 8\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 8\theta=e^{-8\mathrm{i}\theta}$；故乘积为 $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-2\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{4\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-8\mathrm{i}\theta}=e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta-2\theta+4\theta-8\theta)}=e^{-5\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos 5\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 5\theta$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $\cos\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin\theta=e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$, $\cos 2\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 2\theta=e^{-2\mathrm{i}\theta}$, $\cos 4\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 4\theta=e^{4\mathrm{i}\theta}$, $\cos 8\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 8\theta=e^{-8\mathrm{i}\theta}$; hence the product is $e^{\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-2\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{4\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-8\mathrm{i}\theta}=e^{\mathrm{i}(\theta-2\theta+4\theta-8\theta)}=e^{-5\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos 5\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 5\theta$.

note.zh: 指数相加：$1-2+4-8=-5$，故结果为 $5\theta$ 的共轭型。
note.en: The exponents add to $1-2+4-8=-5$, so the result is the conjugate-type term in $5\theta$.

type.en: Simplifying a quotient with De Moivre

q.zh: 化简 $\dfrac{(\cos 3\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 3\theta)(\cos 7\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 7\theta)}{(\cos 2\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 2\theta)(\cos 5\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 5\theta)}$。
q.en: Simplify $\dfrac{(\cos 3\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 3\theta)(\cos 7\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 7\theta)}{(\cos 2\theta+\mathrm{i}\sin 2\theta)(\cos 5\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin 5\theta)}$.

steps.en: The numerator is $e^{3\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-7\mathrm{i}\theta}$ and the denominator is $e^{2\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-5\mathrm{i}\theta}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$\dfrac{e^{3\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-7\mathrm{i}\theta}}{e^{2\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-5\mathrm{i}\theta}}=e^{\mathrm{i}(3\theta-7\theta-2\theta+5\theta)}=e^{-\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $\dfrac{e^{3\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-7\mathrm{i}\theta}}{e^{2\mathrm{i}\theta}e^{-5\mathrm{i}\theta}}=e^{\mathrm{i}(3\theta-7\theta-2\theta+5\theta)}=e^{-\mathrm{i}\theta}=\cos\theta-\mathrm{i}\sin\theta$.

note.zh: 商中分母的指数要「变号」相减：$-(2\theta)+5\theta=+3\theta$，故总指数 $3-7-2+5=-1$。
note.en: In a quotient the denominator's exponents are subtracted with a sign change: $-(2\theta)+5\theta=+3\theta$, so the total exponent is $3-7-2+5=-1$.

type.en: Computing a high power with De Moivre

q.zh: 设 $z=-1+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$，求 $z^8$ 与 $z^{-7}$，答案写成 $a+\mathrm{i}b$ 的形式（$a,b$ 为实数）。
q.en: Let $z=-1+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$. Find $z^8$ and $z^{-7}$, giving your answers in the form $a+\mathrm{i}b$ where $a,b$ are real.

steps.en: $|z|=\sqrt{1+3}=2$; $z$ lies in the second quadrant with argument $\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$, so $z=2e^{\frac{2\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：第二象限作图，辐角 $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$（相对负实轴）；$|z|=\sqrt{1+3}=2$，$z=2e^{\frac{2\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}$；$z^8=2^8e^{\frac{16\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=256e^{\frac{4\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=256\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=-128-128\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$；$z^{-7}=2^{-7}e^{-\frac{14\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=\dfrac{1}{128}e^{-\frac{2\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=\dfrac{1}{128}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=\dfrac{1}{256}-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{256}\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: a diagram in the second quadrant with angle $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ from the negative real axis; $|z|=\sqrt{1+3}=2$ and $z=2e^{\frac{2\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}$; $z^8=2^8e^{\frac{16\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=256e^{\frac{4\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=256\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=-128-128\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$; $z^{-7}=2^{-7}e^{-\frac{14\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=\dfrac{1}{128}e^{-\frac{2\mathrm{i}\pi}{3}}=\dfrac{1}{128}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=\dfrac{1}{256}-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{256}\mathrm{i}$.

type.en: Integers n for which a power is real

q.zh: 设 $z=-1+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$，求整数 $n$ 使 $z^n$ 为实数。
q.en: Let $z=-1+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}$. Find the integers $n$ for which $z^n$ is a real number.

ans.en: $n=3m$ with $m\in\mathbb{Z}$ (that is, $n$ is an integer multiple of $3$)

steps.zh: $z^n$ 为实数当且仅当 $\sin\dfrac{2\pi n}{3}=0$，即 $\dfrac{2\pi n}{3}=k\pi$，故 $2n=3k$。
steps.en: $z^n$ is real iff $\sin\dfrac{2\pi n}{3}=0$, i.e. $\dfrac{2\pi n}{3}=k\pi$, so $2n=3k$.

steps.zh: 要使 $n=\dfrac{3k}{2}$ 为整数，$k$ 必须为偶数，故 $n=3m$，$m\in\mathbb{Z}$。
steps.en: For $n=\dfrac{3k}{2}$ to be an integer, $k$ must be even, so $n=3m$ with $m\in\mathbb{Z}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$z^n=2^n e^{\frac{2\pi\mathrm{i}n}{3}}=2^n\left(\cos\frac{2\pi n}{3}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{2\pi n}{3}\right)$；为实数当且仅当 $\sin\frac{2\pi n}{3}=0$，即 $\frac{2\pi n}{3}=\pi k$，$k\in\mathbb{Z}$，故 $2n=3k$，$n=\frac{3k}{2}$；要使 $\frac{3k}{2}$ 为整数，$k$ 须为 $2$ 的倍数，故 $n=3m$，$m\in\mathbb{Z}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $z^n=2^n e^{\frac{2\pi\mathrm{i}n}{3}}=2^n\left(\cos\frac{2\pi n}{3}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{2\pi n}{3}\right)$; real iff $\sin\frac{2\pi n}{3}=0$, i.e. $\frac{2\pi n}{3}=\pi k$ with $k\in\mathbb{Z}$, so $2n=3k$ and $n=\frac{3k}{2}$; for $\frac{3k}{2}$ to be an integer $k$ must be divisible by $2$, hence $n=3m$ with $m\in\mathbb{Z}$.

note.zh: 注意 $n$ 可以是负整数（如 $n=-3$ 时 $z^{-3}$ 仍为实数），题目只要求整数。
note.en: Note that $n$ may be a negative integer (for $n=-3$, $z^{-3}$ is still real); the question only asks for integers.

type.zh: 求使幂为纯虚数的整数
type.en: Integers n for which a power is purely imaginary

q.zh: 求整数 $n$ 使 $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n$ 为纯虚数。
q.en: Find the integers $n$ for which $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n$ is purely imaginary.

steps.en: $|\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{3+1}=2$; it lies in the fourth quadrant with $\operatorname{Arg}(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$, i.e. $\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}=2e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/6}$.

steps.zh: 由棣莫弗公式 $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n=2^n e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi n/6}=2^n\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi n}{6}-\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\pi n}{6}\right)$。
steps.en: By De Moivre's formula $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n=2^n e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi n/6}=2^n\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi n}{6}-\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{\pi n}{6}\right)$.

steps.zh: 纯虚数要求实部为零，即 $\cos\dfrac{\pi n}{6}=0$，即 $\dfrac{\pi n}{6}=\dfrac{(2k+1)\pi}{2}$，故 $n=6k+3$，$k\in\mathbb{Z}$。
steps.en: Purely imaginary means the real part vanishes, i.e. $\cos\dfrac{\pi n}{6}=0$, i.e. $\dfrac{\pi n}{6}=\dfrac{(2k+1)\pi}{2}$, so $n=6k+3$ with $k\in\mathbb{Z}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：第四象限作图，与正实轴成 $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$；$|\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{3+1}=2$，$\operatorname{Arg}(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$，$\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}=2e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/6}$；由棣莫弗公式 $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n=2^n e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi n/6}=2^n\left(\cos\frac{\pi n}{6}-\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{\pi n}{6}\right)$；为纯虚数当且仅当 $\cos\frac{\pi n}{6}=0$，即 $\frac{\pi n}{6}=\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{2}$，$k$ 为整数，故 $n=6k+3$，$k\in\mathbb{Z}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: a diagram in the fourth quadrant with angle $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$ below the positive real axis; $|\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{3+1}=2$, $\operatorname{Arg}(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$, $\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}=2e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/6}$; by De Moivre's formula $(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})^n=2^n e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi n/6}=2^n\left(\cos\frac{\pi n}{6}-\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{\pi n}{6}\right)$; purely imaginary iff $\cos\frac{\pi n}{6}=0$, i.e. $\frac{\pi n}{6}=\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{2}$ for some integer $k$, so $n=6k+3$ with $k\in\mathbb{Z}$.

note.zh: 对比第 3.17(b)：求实数用 $\sin=0$，求纯虚数用 $\cos=0$，条件正好互换。
note.en: Compare with Problem 3.17(b): reality uses $\sin=0$ while pure imaginaryity uses $\cos=0$; the two conditions are interchanged.

q.zh: 计算 $(1+\mathrm{i})\left(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}\right)^7$，答案写成 $a+\mathrm{i}b$ 的形式（$a,b$ 为实数）。
q.en: Compute $(1+\mathrm{i})\left(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}\right)^7$, giving your answer in the form $a+\mathrm{i}b$ where $a,b$ are real.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：第四象限作图，角度 $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$；$|\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{3+1}=2$，$\arg(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$，$\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}=2e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/6}$；$\left(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}\right)^7=2^7e^{-\mathrm{i}7\pi/6}=128\left(\cos\frac{7\pi}{6}-\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{7\pi}{6}\right)=128\left(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+\frac{\mathrm{i}}{2}\right)=-64\sqrt{3}+64\mathrm{i}$；$(1+\mathrm{i})\left(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}\right)^7=-64\sqrt{3}+64\mathrm{i}-64\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}-64=-64(\sqrt{3}+1)-64(\sqrt{3}-1)\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: a diagram in the fourth quadrant with angle $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$; $|\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}|=\sqrt{3+1}=2$, $\arg(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i})=-\dfrac{\pi}{6}$, $\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}=2e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/6}$; $\left(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}\right)^7=2^7e^{-\mathrm{i}7\pi/6}=128\left(\cos\frac{7\pi}{6}-\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{7\pi}{6}\right)=128\left(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+\frac{\mathrm{i}}{2}\right)=-64\sqrt{3}+64\mathrm{i}$; $(1+\mathrm{i})\left(\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}\right)^7=-64\sqrt{3}+64\mathrm{i}-64\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}-64=-64(\sqrt{3}+1)-64(\sqrt{3}-1)\mathrm{i}$.

note.en: Check: the modulus should be $|1+\mathrm{i}|\cdot|\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}|^7=\sqrt{2}\cdot 128=128\sqrt{2}$, and $\sqrt{\left(64(\sqrt{3}+1)\right)^2+\left(64(\sqrt{3}-1)\right)^2}=64\sqrt{8}=128\sqrt{2}$.

q.zh: 计算 $\dfrac{(1-\mathrm{i})^{10}}{(\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i})^5}$，答案写成 $a+\mathrm{i}b$ 的形式（$a,b$ 为实数）。
q.en: Compute $\dfrac{(1-\mathrm{i})^{10}}{(\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i})^5}$, giving your answer in the form $a+\mathrm{i}b$ where $a,b$ are real.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$1-\mathrm{i}=2^{1/2}e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/4}$，$(1-\mathrm{i})^{10}=2^5e^{-5\mathrm{i}\pi/2}=2^5e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/2}$；$\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i}=2e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/6}$，$(\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i})^5=2^5e^{\mathrm{i}5\pi/6}$；故商 $=\frac{2^5e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/2}}{2^5e^{\mathrm{i}5\pi/6}}=e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi\left(\frac12+\frac56\right)}=e^{-\mathrm{i}4\pi/3}=\cos\frac{4\pi}{3}-\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{4\pi}{3}=-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $1-\mathrm{i}=2^{1/2}e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/4}$, $(1-\mathrm{i})^{10}=2^5e^{-5\mathrm{i}\pi/2}=2^5e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/2}$; $\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i}=2e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/6}$, $(\sqrt{3}+\mathrm{i})^5=2^5e^{\mathrm{i}5\pi/6}$; hence the quotient $=\frac{2^5e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi/2}}{2^5e^{\mathrm{i}5\pi/6}}=e^{-\mathrm{i}\pi\left(\frac12+\frac56\right)}=e^{-\mathrm{i}4\pi/3}=\cos\frac{4\pi}{3}-\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{4\pi}{3}=-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}$.

q.zh: 计算 $\left(\dfrac{1-\mathrm{i}}{1+\mathrm{i}}\right)^n$，其中 $n$ 为正整数。
q.en: Compute $\left(\dfrac{1-\mathrm{i}}{1+\mathrm{i}}\right)^n$, where $n$ is a positive integer.

steps.zh: 故原式为 $(-\mathrm{i})^n$（即 $(-1)^n\mathrm{i}^n$），按 $n$ 除以 $4$ 的余数循环。
steps.en: So the expression is $(-\mathrm{i})^n$ (that is $(-1)^n\mathrm{i}^n$), cycling with the remainder of $n$ modulo $4$.
For remainders $0,1,2,3$ the values are $1$, $-\mathrm{i}$, $-1$, $\mathrm{i}$ respectively.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$\dfrac{1-\mathrm{i}}{1+\mathrm{i}}=\dfrac{(1-\mathrm{i})(1-\mathrm{i})}{(1+\mathrm{i})(1-\mathrm{i})}=\dfrac{1-2\mathrm{i}+\mathrm{i}^2}{2}=-\mathrm{i}$；故 $\left(\frac{1-\mathrm{i}}{1+\mathrm{i}}\right)^n=(-1)^n\mathrm{i}^n=\begin{cases}1,& n=4k\\-\mathrm{i},& n=4k+1\\-1,& n=4k+2\\\mathrm{i},& n=4k+3\end{cases}$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $\dfrac{1-\mathrm{i}}{1+\mathrm{i}}=\dfrac{(1-\mathrm{i})(1-\mathrm{i})}{(1+\mathrm{i})(1-\mathrm{i})}=\dfrac{1-2\mathrm{i}+\mathrm{i}^2}{2}=-\mathrm{i}$; hence $\left(\frac{1-\mathrm{i}}{1+\mathrm{i}}\right)^n=(-1)^n\mathrm{i}^n=\begin{cases}1,& n=4k\\-\mathrm{i},& n=4k+1\\-1,& n=4k+2\\\mathrm{i},& n=4k+3\end{cases}$.

note.zh: 讲义例 3.17 与本讲义例题都给出同一结论：$(1+\mathrm{i})^n$ 按 $n$ 模 $4$ 循环。
note.en: Lecture Example 3.17 gives the same pattern for $(1+\mathrm{i})^n$, cycling with $n$ modulo $4$.

q.zh: 求 $(1+\mathrm{i})(1+2\mathrm{i})(1+3\mathrm{i})$。
q.en: Find $(1+\mathrm{i})(1+2\mathrm{i})(1+3\mathrm{i})$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$(1+\mathrm{i})(1+2\mathrm{i})=1+3\mathrm{i}+2\mathrm{i}^2=-1+3\mathrm{i}$；$(1+\mathrm{i})(1+2\mathrm{i})(1+3\mathrm{i})=(-1+3\mathrm{i})(1+3\mathrm{i})=-1+(3\mathrm{i})^2=-1-9=-10$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $(1+\mathrm{i})(1+2\mathrm{i})=1+3\mathrm{i}+2\mathrm{i}^2=-1+3\mathrm{i}$; $(1+\mathrm{i})(1+2\mathrm{i})(1+3\mathrm{i})=(-1+3\mathrm{i})(1+3\mathrm{i})=-1+(3\mathrm{i})^2=-1-9=-10$.

note.zh: 核对：三个因子的辐角之和为 $\arctan 1+\arctan 2+\arctan 3=\pi$，与结果 $-10$（辐角 $\pi$）一致。
note.en: Check: the sum of the arguments of the three factors is $\arctan 1+\arctan 2+\arctan 3=\pi$, consistent with the result $-10$ whose argument is $\pi$.

type.zh: 用辐角证明反正切恒等式
type.en: Proving a tangent identity using arguments

q.en: Use part (a) to show that $\tan^{-1}1+\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3=\pi$.

steps.en: Also $0<\tan^{-1}1+\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$, so $0<\pi+2k\pi<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$ forces $k=0$, giving the sum as $\pi$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$\arg(1+\mathrm{i})+\arg(1+2\mathrm{i})+\arg(1+3\mathrm{i})=\arg(-10)=\pi+2k\pi$，$k\in\mathbb{Z}$；旁注：若 $x,y>0$ 则 $\arg(x+\mathrm{i}y)=\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x}$；并且 $0<\tan^{-1}1<\frac{\pi}{2}$，$0<\tan^{-1}2<\frac{\pi}{2}$，$0<\tan^{-1}3<\frac{\pi}{2}$，故 $0<\tan^{-1}1+\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3<\frac{3\pi}{2}$；若整数 $k$ 满足 $0<\pi+2k\pi<\frac{3\pi}{2}$，必有 $k=0$，因此 $\tan^{-1}1+\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3=\pi$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $\arg(1+\mathrm{i})+\arg(1+2\mathrm{i})+\arg(1+3\mathrm{i})=\arg(-10)=\pi+2k\pi$ with $k\in\mathbb{Z}$; side note: if $x,y>0$ then $\arg(x+\mathrm{i}y)=\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x}$; moreover $0<\tan^{-1}1<\frac{\pi}{2}$, $0<\tan^{-1}2<\frac{\pi}{2}$, $0<\tan^{-1}3<\frac{\pi}{2}$, hence $0<\tan^{-1}1+\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3<\frac{3\pi}{2}$; if an integer $k$ satisfies $0<\pi+2k\pi<\frac{3\pi}{2}$ then $k=0$, therefore $\tan^{-1}1+\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3=\pi$.

note.zh: 关键点：辐角之和只确定到模 $2\pi$，必须再用取值范围夹逼才能定出唯一的 $k$。
note.en: Key point: the sum of arguments is only determined modulo $2\pi$; a range argument is needed to pin down $k$.

q.zh: 求 $-16+16\mathrm{i}$ 的三次方根，答案写成 $a+\mathrm{i}b$ 的形式（$a,b$ 为实数）。
q.en: Find the cube roots of $-16+16\mathrm{i}$, expressing your answers in the form $a+\mathrm{i}b$ where $a,b$ are real.

steps.en: The modulus of $-16+16\mathrm{i}$ is $16\sqrt{2}=2^{9/2}$ and its argument is $\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$, so $-16+16\mathrm{i}=2^{9/2}e^{\mathrm{i}3\pi/4}$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：第二象限作图，辐角 $\frac{3\pi}{4}$；$-16+16\mathrm{i}=2^4\times\sqrt{2}\,e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{3\pi}{4}+2k\pi\mathrm{i}}=2^{9/2}e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{3\pi}{4}+2k\pi\mathrm{i}}$；故 $z=2^{3/2}e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{2k\pi\mathrm{i}}{3}}$，$k=0,1,2$；$k=0$ 时 $z_0=2\sqrt{2}e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}=2+2\mathrm{i}$；$k=1$ 时 $z_1=(2+2\mathrm{i})\left(-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=-1-\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}=-(1+\sqrt{3})+\mathrm{i}(\sqrt{3}-1)$；$k=2$ 时 $z_2=(2+2\mathrm{i})\left(-\frac12-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=-1+\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}=\sqrt{3}-1-\mathrm{i}(\sqrt{3}+1)$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: a diagram in the second quadrant with argument $\frac{3\pi}{4}$; $-16+16\mathrm{i}=2^4\times\sqrt{2}\,e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{3\pi}{4}+2k\pi\mathrm{i}}=2^{9/2}e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{3\pi}{4}+2k\pi\mathrm{i}}$; hence $z=2^{3/2}e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{2k\pi\mathrm{i}}{3}}$ with $k=0,1,2$; for $k=0$, $z_0=2\sqrt{2}e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}=2+2\mathrm{i}$; for $k=1$, $z_1=(2+2\mathrm{i})\left(-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=-1-\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}+\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}=-(1+\sqrt{3})+\mathrm{i}(\sqrt{3}-1)$; for $k=2$, $z_2=(2+2\mathrm{i})\left(-\frac12-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\mathrm{i}\right)=-1+\sqrt{3}-\mathrm{i}-\sqrt{3}\mathrm{i}=\sqrt{3}-1-\mathrm{i}(\sqrt{3}+1)$.

note.zh: 核对：三个根的模都等于 $\left|-16+16\mathrm{i}\right|^{1/3}=(16\sqrt{2})^{1/3}=2\sqrt{2}$；辐角分别为 $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$、$\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$、$\dfrac{19\pi}{12}$，相差 $\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$。
note.en: Check: all three roots have modulus $\left|-16+16\mathrm{i}\right|^{1/3}=(16\sqrt{2})^{1/3}=2\sqrt{2}$, with arguments $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$, $\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$ and $\dfrac{19\pi}{12}$, spaced by $\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$.

type.zh: 求四次根并在阿甘图上表示
type.en: Finding fourth roots and representing them on an Argand diagram

q.zh: 求 $-81$ 的四次方根，答案写成 $a+\mathrm{i}b$ 的形式（$a,b$ 为实数），并在阿甘图上表示这些解。
q.en: Find the fourth roots of $-81$, expressing your answers in the form $a+\mathrm{i}b$ where $a,b$ are real, and represent the solutions on an Argand diagram.

ans.zh: $z_0=3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(1+\mathrm{i})$，$z_1=3e^{\mathrm{3i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(-1+\mathrm{i})$，$z_2=3e^{\mathrm{5i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(-1-\mathrm{i})$，$z_3=3e^{\mathrm{7i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(1-\mathrm{i})$（四点均在以原点为圆心、半径 $3$ 的圆上，等距分布）
ans.en: $z_0=3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(1+\mathrm{i})$, $z_1=3e^{\mathrm{3i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(-1+\mathrm{i})$, $z_2=3e^{\mathrm{5i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(-1-\mathrm{i})$ and $z_3=3e^{\mathrm{7i}\pi/4}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}(1-\mathrm{i})$ (all four lie on the circle of radius $3$ about the origin, equally spaced)

steps.en: If $z^4=-81$ then $z=3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{4}}$ for $k=0,1,2,3$, four roots in total.

steps.zh: 阿甘图：四点在半径 $3$ 的圆上依次位于第一、第二、第三、第四象限，辐角为 $\dfrac{\pi}{4},\dfrac{3\pi}{4},\dfrac{5\pi}{4},\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$；$z_0z_2$ 与 $z_1z_3$ 连成的弦互相垂直且过原点。
steps.en: Argand diagram: the four points lie on the circle of radius $3$, in the first, second, third and fourth quadrants with arguments $\dfrac{\pi}{4},\dfrac{3\pi}{4},\dfrac{5\pi}{4},\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$; the chords $z_0z_2$ and $z_1z_3$ are perpendicular and pass through the origin.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：设 $z$ 是 $-81$ 的四次根，则 $z^4=-81=3^4e^{\mathrm{i}(\pi+2k\pi)}$，故 $z=3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{4}}$，$k=0,1,2,3$；$z_0=3e^{\frac{\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}+\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$，$z_1=3e^{\frac{3\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=-\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}+\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$，$z_2=3e^{\frac{5\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=-\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}-\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$，$z_3=3e^{\frac{7\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}-\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$；阿甘图上四点等距分布在以原点为圆心、半径 $3$ 的圆上，$z_0z_2$ 与 $z_1z_3$ 互相垂直。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: if $z$ is a fourth root of $-81$ then $z^4=-81=3^4e^{\mathrm{i}(\pi+2k\pi)}$, so $z=3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{4}}$ for $k=0,1,2,3$; $z_0=3e^{\frac{\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}+\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$, $z_1=3e^{\frac{3\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=-\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}+\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$, $z_2=3e^{\frac{5\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=-\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}-\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$, $z_3=3e^{\frac{7\mathrm{i}\pi}{4}}=\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}-\frac{3\mathrm{i}}{\sqrt{2}}$; on the Argand diagram the four roots are equally spaced on the circle of radius $3$ about the origin, with $z_0z_2$ and $z_1z_3$ perpendicular.

note.zh: 注意 $-81$ 的辐角为 $\pi+2k\pi$，若只写 $\pi$ 就只能得到 $3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}$ 一个根。
note.en: Note that the argument of $-81$ is $\pi+2k\pi$; using only $\pi$ would give the single root $3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/4}$.

type.zh: 求七次根并在阿甘图上表示
type.en: Finding seventh roots and representing them on an Argand diagram

q.zh: 求 $128$ 的七次方根，答案写成三角形式，并在阿甘图上表示这些解。
q.en: Find the seventh roots of $128$, expressing your answers in trigonometric forms, and represent the solutions on an Argand diagram.

ans.zh: $z_k=2\left(\cos\dfrac{2k\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{2k\pi}{7}\right)$，$k=0,1,\dots,6$（七点在以原点为圆心、半径 $2$ 的圆上等距分布，$z_0=2$ 位于正实轴上）
ans.en: $z_k=2\left(\cos\dfrac{2k\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{2k\pi}{7}\right)$ for $k=0,1,\dots,6$ (seven equally spaced points on the circle of radius $2$ about the origin, with $z_0=2$ on the positive real axis)

steps.zh: 三角形式为 $z_k=2\left(\cos\dfrac{2k\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\dfrac{2k\pi}{7}\right)$，辐角依次为 $0,\dfrac{2\pi}{7},\dfrac{4\pi}{7},\dfrac{6\pi}{7},\dfrac{8\pi}{7},\dfrac{10\pi}{7},\dfrac{12\pi}{7}$。
阿甘图：七点在半径 $2$ 的圆上等距分布，$z_0=2$ 在正实轴上，各根与原点相连。
steps.en: Argand diagram: the seven points are equally spaced on the circle of radius $2$, with $z_0=2$ on the positive real axis and radius lines drawn from the origin.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：设 $z$ 是 $128$ 的七次根，则 $z^7=128=2^7e^{2\pi\mathrm{i}k}$，故 $z=2e^{\frac{2\pi\mathrm{i}k}{7}}$，$k=0,1,2,3,4,5,6$；$z_0=2(\cos 0+\mathrm{i}\sin 0)$，$z_1=2(\cos\frac{2\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{2\pi}{7})$，$z_2=2(\cos\frac{4\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{4\pi}{7})$，$z_3=2(\cos\frac{6\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{6\pi}{7})$，$z_4=2(\cos\frac{8\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{8\pi}{7})$，$z_5=2(\cos\frac{10\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{10\pi}{7})$，$z_6=2(\cos\frac{12\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{12\pi}{7})$；阿甘图为以原点为圆心、半径 $2$ 的圆，七个根对称分布，$z_0=(2,0)$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: if $z$ is a seventh root of $128$ then $z^7=128=2^7e^{2\pi\mathrm{i}k}$, so $z=2e^{\frac{2\pi\mathrm{i}k}{7}}$ for $k=0,1,2,3,4,5,6$; $z_0=2(\cos 0+\mathrm{i}\sin 0)$, $z_1=2(\cos\frac{2\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{2\pi}{7})$, $z_2=2(\cos\frac{4\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{4\pi}{7})$, $z_3=2(\cos\frac{6\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{6\pi}{7})$, $z_4=2(\cos\frac{8\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{8\pi}{7})$, $z_5=2(\cos\frac{10\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{10\pi}{7})$, $z_6=2(\cos\frac{12\pi}{7}+\mathrm{i}\sin\frac{12\pi}{7})$; the Argand diagram is the circle of radius $2$ about the origin with the seven roots symmetrically placed and $z_0=(2,0)$.

note.zh: 对照讲义例 3.20（$-32\mathrm{i}$ 的五次根）与例 3.21（$-64$ 的六次根），注意 $-32\mathrm{i}$ 的辐角是 $-\dfrac{\pi}{2}$，$-64$ 的辐角是 $\pi$。
note.en: Compare with lecture Example 3.20 (fifth roots of $-32\mathrm{i}$) and Example 3.21 (sixth roots of $-64$): note that the argument of $-32\mathrm{i}$ is $-\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ and that of $-64$ is $\pi$.

type.zh: 用 n 次根解方程并作图
type.en: Solving an equation with n-th roots and sketching

q.zh: 解方程 $(z-2)^5+243=0$，并在阿甘图上表示这些解。
q.en: Solve the equation $(z-2)^5+243=0$ and represent the solutions on an Argand diagram.

ans.en: $z=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{5}}$ for $k=0,1,2,3,4$, i.e. $z_0=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/5}$, $z_1=2+3e^{\mathrm{3i}\pi/5}$, $z_2=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi}=-1$, $z_3=2+3e^{\mathrm{7i}\pi/5}$, $z_4=2+3e^{\mathrm{9i}\pi/5}$ (five points on the circle with centre $2$, i.e. $(2,0)$, and radius $3$)

steps.en: Taking fifth roots of both sides: $z-2=3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{5}}$ for $k=0,1,2,3,4$.

Translating back gives $z=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{5}}$, with the five solutions $2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi/5}$, $2+3e^{\mathrm{3i}\pi/5}$, $2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi}=-1$, $2+3e^{\mathrm{7i}\pi/5}$ and $2+3e^{\mathrm{9i}\pi/5}$.

steps.zh: 阿甘图：以 $2$（点 $(2,0)$）为圆心、半径 $3$ 的圆上五个等距点，辐角依次为 $\dfrac{\pi}{5},\dfrac{3\pi}{5},\pi,\dfrac{7\pi}{5},\dfrac{9\pi}{5}$；实轴标出 $-1,0,2,5$。
steps.en: Argand diagram: five equally spaced points on the circle with centre $2$ (the point $(2,0)$) and radius $3$, with arguments $\dfrac{\pi}{5},\dfrac{3\pi}{5},\pi,\dfrac{7\pi}{5},\dfrac{9\pi}{5}$; the real axis is marked $-1,0,2,5$.

official.zh: 官方手写解答：$(z-2)^5=-243=3^5e^{\mathrm{i}(2k+1)\pi}$；$z-2=3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{5}}$，$k=0,1,2,3,4$；解为 $z_0=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{\pi}{5}}$，$z_1=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{3\pi}{5}}$，$z_2=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi}=-1$，$z_3=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{7\pi}{5}}$，$z_4=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{9\pi}{5}}$；阿甘图为半径 $3$、圆心为 $z=2$ 的圆，五个等距顶点与圆心相连，实轴标出 $-1,0,2,5$。
official.en: Official handwritten solution: $(z-2)^5=-243=3^5e^{\mathrm{i}(2k+1)\pi}$; $z-2=3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{5}}$ for $k=0,1,2,3,4$; the solutions are $z_0=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{\pi}{5}}$, $z_1=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{3\pi}{5}}$, $z_2=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\pi}=-1$, $z_3=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{7\pi}{5}}$, $z_4=2+3e^{\mathrm{i}\frac{9\pi}{5}}$; the Argand diagram is the circle of radius $3$ centred at $z=2$ with five equally spaced vertices joined to the centre, and the real axis marked $-1,0,2,5$.

note.en: Check: for $z=-1$, $(z-2)^5=(-3)^5=-243$, so $z=-1$ is indeed a solution; the other four roots likewise satisfy $(z-2)^5=-243$.
